Metadata.title: Evony Alliance Dashboard
Metadata.description: Build your Evony alliance's dashboard, track its evolution, and generate its Hive Composition.

Nav.daysRemaining: {count, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}

Home.heading: Steer your alliance's <gold>strategy</gold>
Home.subtitle: Build your Evony alliance's dashboard, track its evolution, and automatically generate its Hive Composition: power, buffs, combat placement.
Home.hiveCaption: Automatically generated example: the Setter at the center, best attacks placed by increasing Euclidean distance.
Home.capability1Body: Setter, Attack/Defense Score, and Hive Composition are derived automatically from your stats. No manual calculation.
Home.capability2Body: Every save is historized: power and buff progression builds itself, no manual tracking effort.
Home.capability3Body: No spreadsheet to maintain, no bot to configure. Create your alliance and start tracking your accounts.
Home.step1Body: Sign up in a few seconds.
Home.step2Body: Free. An admin can also link you to an existing alliance.
Home.step3Body: Free, Buffs Analysis, or Battlefield depending on the features you need.
Home.step4Body: Enter your accounts, the dashboard does the rest.

Pricing.title: Subscriptions
Pricing.subtitle: Every player gets Free access automatically. Buffs Analysis and Battlefield unlock more features for you personally — each member of an alliance subscribes on their own.
howItWorksSteps: Click "Pay with PayPal" for the subscription you want.
Then click "Request activation", including your payment reference if possible.
An administrator activates your subscription after verifying the payment.
